title: errorMessage
responsibility: Converts thrown values to readable messages without changing their text.

inputs.name: errorMessage.cause
inputs.description: Any thrown JavaScript value, including null and undefined.

outputs.name: errorMessage
outputs.description: Error.message for Error instances; String(cause) otherwise. String conversion errors propagate.

errors.name: Message conversion error
errors.description: Errors from an Error.message accessor or String(cause) conversion propagate unchanged.
